comic_engine: Self-appointed captain can command neither packing, airport machines nor his own fear; Buddy quietly manages his comfort and then helps him.

wants.Neet: Be in charge of the grand adventure
wants.Buddy: Keep familiar blanket accessible and travel quietly

changes: Blanket packing tug establishes Buddy active comfort agenda
Heather silently replaces captain with sweater
Lying-down flight claim permits Buddy shared vulnerability
Snack cart reverses airport cart hostility
Final captain question earns dry callback
earned_ending: Buddy can relax because he has helped his nervous brother; captain remains comically occupied with the view.
variant_decisions: No meaningful alternative in shelf file or original mapping; historical Heather-only household preserved, no Sagar insertion.

observations: Every original travel incident retained in original sequence
Prior working Buddy blanket want and reassurance decision retained
No invented transit logistics or resolved breed/rank/chronology
Expansion adds short causal jokes, not new subplot; removed original generic next-chapter preview remains removed
